excluded_types.name: NxProfiler_DefineZone
excluded_types.reason: UNDERIVABLE UNDER THE TARGET ABI - not merely unverified, and not closed by verifying it. Foundation/include/NxProfiler.h:76 declares 'class DefineZone : public NxAllocateable, public NxProfilingZone', the only multiple-inheritance site in either pinned tree. NxAllocateable declares only operator new/delete, so it is empty and non-polymorphic; NxProfilingZone declares three pure virtuals, so it is polymorphic and forces a vftable slot. Deriving the layout would require assuming the empty base is elided, and MSVC's default Win32 ABI does not reliably apply empty-base optimization when a class has multiple bases - that is precisely why __declspec(empty_bases) was later added to the compiler. For the 2003-era MSVC that built this DLL, 'EBO applies' is a coin flip, not a conservative default, and guessing wrong would place the vftable slot and every field after it at the wrong offset while decompiling confidently. R4 therefore withholds the type rather than emitting a layout it cannot derive. Nothing in the Physics tree reaches it: NxPerformanceInspector is declared in Physics/include/NxSceneStats.h, not here, and all three of NxProfiler's DefineZone members (NxProfiler.h:153, :169, :188) are static. The generator hard-errors if this type ever becomes reachable.

forced_declarations.name: NxArray<NxShapeDesc*>
forced_declarations.reason: Class template instantiation; R6 does not instantiate templates. The three pointer fields are the 'Iterator first, last, memEnd;' declared at Foundation/include/NxArray.h:410, with Iterator = ElemType* per NxArray.h:26. The trailing field stands for the 'AllocType allocator;' at NxArray.h:412, whose type NxAllocatorDefault declares only member functions. ASSUMPTION NOT YET VERIFIED AGAINST THE BINARY: this assumes MSVC empty-base optimization for the NxAllocateable base (0 bytes) and a 1-byte empty-class member padded to the struct's 4-byte alignment, giving 16 bytes total. Task 5 must confirm the size against the oracle before any reconstruction relies on it.

type_selection_rules: R0 file-scope typedefs are emitted in declaration order.

R1 every tagged enum becomes a C enum whose enumerators are evaluated to literal integers, widened with a generator-added <Name>__nx_force_32bit enumerator when its own values do not reach 32 bits, so it matches the 4-byte underlying type MSVC gives every enum.

R2 every tagged class or struct becomes a C struct of its data members in declaration order; member functions, inline bodies, operators, constructors, destructors, static members and in-body typedefs declare no storage and are dropped. An in-body typedef still names a type and is recorded as a scope alias.

R3 a class gains a leading void **__vftable only when it introduces virtual members and does not already inherit a vftable from its base chain. A class that introduces virtual members over a base with no vftable is rejected, because MSVC would place the pointer before the base subobject. A virtual member of a nested type belongs to that nested type, not to its enclosing class.

R4 a class with one non-virtual base embeds it first as __base_<Base>, by the same code path for nested and top-level classes. Multiple and virtual inheritance are not derived: the type is withheld under R9 rather than emitted with a guessed layout.
R5 C++ references become pointers, top-level const is dropped, and bool and __int64 are replaced by their layout-identical C spellings.

R6 templates are not instantiated; a member naming one resolves through a forced declaration, whose reason is emitted as a comment above it. A forced declaration may not supply a layout for a type the headers define, and may not name a type withheld under R9.

R7 free functions declared NX_C_EXPORT NXP_DLL_EXPORT become C prototypes carrying their calling convention; an extern "C" declaration with no parameter list is recognized as a variable and contributes no prototype.

R8 any construct outside this subset is rejected by file and line; nothing is skipped in silence. A type withheld under R9 is the one thing not emitted, and it leaves a visible marker in its place rather than nothing.

R9 excluded_types withholds a named type whose layout is not derivable under the target ABI. Each entry carries a reason; a name no pinned header declares is an error; the withheld type leaves a /* excluded type: ... */ marker where it would have appeared, which ApplyPhysicsTypes.java reads back out of the shim into the manifest; and the generator hard-errors if a withheld type is reachable from an export signature, a base clause, a member of any emitted type, or a forced declaration body.
R10 excluded_headers withholds a whole header that is not part of a Win32 configuration. Its bytes are still verified against the pinned manifest; only its declarations are skipped.
